reviewer: Agent3 author self-review; no independent agent launched

requirements.gidOnly: Original Alice body/credentials/ALLOW cert retained; only forwarded gid Bob changes
requirements.native: Original and substituted mined hash/calldata/recipient/relay/block joins; owned PublicChain submission
requirements.signatures: Existing historical verification plus collector repeats user/witness recovery
requirements.snapshots: Full decoded histories/all deployment contracts and request/grant/two nonces/count/worker; per-chain block anchors
requirements.repaired: Mined status0/Rejected2, no receipt event, entire pre/post state equality
requirements.paper: One Bob grant under original derived grantId; zero native recipient; exact30s TTL and access/event joins
requirements.selection: Invalid subject/fault/control combinations reject before adapter/request side effects
requirements.scope: Stops before release; no legitimate Alice release attempted with Bob grant

limitations: Pre-release only; recipient routing/completion/fresh controls/complete ACKed plan/live run remain
Author review has correlated blind spots; no independent final review under no-extra-agent instruction
RPC boundary consistency is not provider authentication/consensus
Synthetic classification is not a finding or gate result
